Clients notice the lobby. Your team notices the break room and the restroom. A small office doesn't need a big janitorial contract, but it does need someone reliable who shows up, cleans properly and doesn't need to be managed. That's what our office cleaning in Richardson, TX is for.

Your office cleaning checklist

Workspaces and common areas

  • Desks and work surfaces dusted and wiped (we work around papers and equipment, so clear what you'd like cleaned)
  • Reachable surfaces, shelves and window sills dusted
  • Door handles, light switches and other high-touch spots wiped
  • Glass doors, partitions and mirrors cleaned
  • Trash and recycling emptied

Break room or kitchenette

  • Counters, sink and backsplash cleaned and sanitized
  • Microwave wiped inside and out
  • Appliance exteriors and cabinet fronts wiped
  • Tables and chairs wiped

Restrooms

  • Toilets, sinks, counters and mirrors cleaned and sanitized
  • Fixtures polished
  • Floors cleaned

Floors throughout

  • Carpets and rugs vacuumed
  • Hard floors vacuumed and mopped

Ask us about: baseboards, inside the refrigerator, interior windows and a periodic detail clean. Tell us what matters most to your space and we'll build it into your quote.

Small business cleaning that fits your schedule

We clean during our business hours, Monday through Sunday, 8:30 AM–7:30 PM. That gives small businesses plenty of options:

  • Early in the day, before clients start arriving
  • Late afternoon or early evening, as the team wraps up
  • Weekends, when the office is empty and we can work without interruptions

Choose a one-time clean, or set a regular schedule, weekly, every other week or monthly, so you never have to think about it. Cleaning works best when it's consistent, and we try to send the same cleaner every visit so they learn your space.

How to get an office cleaning quote

Our online instant quote is built for homes, so office quotes are handled personally.

  1. Call or email us. Reach us at (469) 210-8005 or info@sotecleaning.com.
  2. Tell us about your space. Share the approximate square footage, number of restrooms, any break room or kitchen, how often you'd like cleaning and the days and times that work best.
  3. Get your quote and schedule. We'll put together a quote and pick a time within our hours. Payment is collected after the clean is complete.
